standard-dialogue-attempting-to-enter-th.npc: This is a restricted area. You can only enter under the authority of King Lathas.

standard-dialogue-crossbow-guard-normal.player: I'm more of an adventurer really.

standard-dialogue-crossbow-guard-normal.npc: In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!

standard-dialogue-crossbow-guard-three-g.npc: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.

standard-dialogue-mace-guard.npc: What do you want? Leave us be!
